shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — island-aware logistics with relay demand, vanilla-exact formation goto, one-step reinstall, forbiddable stairs, cross-level pens/meditation foci/cell psycasts, ritual prisoner+animal gathers, rooftop airship landings, sky visitors, Hospitality guest roaming, column-wide areas, CE-supported cross-level combat, elevators, opt-in threats, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message on trip. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps in Find.Maps, tick every game tick). Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable).

## PARITY BATCH A (2026-07-24) — USER-VERIFIED
- **FORMATION GOTO (vanilla-exact)**: ABBelowGotoDrag = full MultiPawnGotoController mirror (drag-line lerped roots, BestOrderedGotoDestNear spacing + dests exclusion, DragGoto tick, 10t recompute, between-line, ghosts + circles + labels via LevelComp.MapComponentOnGUI). All selection mixes; cross pawns previewed from their stair exit (virtual swap), routed + replayed on release.
- **ONE-STEP REINSTALL** (Logistics/ReinstallAcrossLevels.cs): cross-level reinstall blueprint spawn auto-adds Uninstall designation on the source building; vanilla uninstalls, detector migrates, mini ferried, vanilla installs. Cancel removes the designation. TargetLevelFor skips blueprint-referenced minis (anti-bounce; urgent ignorePins wins).
- **STAIR FORBID — door parity**: CompForbiddable on stairs/ladders/elevators (not utility links). Mirrors IsForbiddenToPass exactly (comp-only, faction-scoped, drafted respect it, hostiles/mental ignore, allowed-area NEVER consulted). Either end seals the passage incl. elevator middle. Gated: NearestUsableStairs, StairRouter, StairIslands, relay anchors, float menus, driver FailOn. API: EndForbidden/EndForbiddenFor/PassageForbiddenFor/PassageForbiddenForColony.

## PARITY BATCH B (2026-07-24) — built, verification pending
- **NATURAL MEDITATION FOCI** (MeditationAcrossLevels): psycasters with no assigned spot probe vanilla FindMeditationSpot on linked levels (virtual swap at stair exit); ride stairs when a strictly stronger focus (anima tree) waits (+0.05 hysteresis). Non-psylink pawns never travel.
- **PENS ACROSS LEVELS** (Systems/PenAcrossLevels.cs): WorkGiver_ABTakeToPenAcrossLevels (Handling, priorityInType 25) — auto rehome ONLY when no local pen accepts (vanilla owns same-level); vanilla GetPenAnimalShouldBeTakenTo probed under DOUBLE virtual swap (handler + animal at exit). Driver AB_TakeToPenAcrossLevels: rope -> lead to stairs (roped follow is native) -> transfer both -> ABPendingOrders replay issues vanilla RopeToPen on arrival. Settled/enclosed animals never touched; pen food/grazing per-level.
- **CELL-TARGETED CASTS** (CrossLevelTargeting.TryHandleGenericCell): Skip destinations / AoE ground casts — any ITargetingSource whose targetParams accept a location, clicked through open air: route-then-cast (caster rides stairs, vanilla cast job on arrival). Mortar arc path unchanged.
- **RITUAL PRISONERS + ANIMALS** (ABRitualAttendance): SECURE prisoners now merge into candidates and walk themselves over (vanilla-duty parity); colony animals merge via new SpawnedColonyAnimals getter patch (same scope/reentrancy guards) and ride the stairs in the gather. Downed participants still can't cross (timeout cancels) — disclosed.

## PARITY BATCH C (2026-07-24) — built, verification pending (needs companion mods)
- **ROOFTOP AIRSHIP LANDINGS** (Compat/ABAirshipsCompat.cs): Medieval Trader Airships (+legacy TraderShips namespace) — LandShip ref-prefix redirects the LANDING map to the sky level exactly when the host mod's landing zone is painted on the rooftop and the surface zone is empty. Player-controlled via the host mod's own tool; no settings. Generation/registration/departure untouched. Trading = physical walk-up via existing float-menu wrap.
- **SKY VISITOR ARRIVALS** (Threats/SkyArrivals.cs): visitor + traveler groups (vanilla and Hospitality's override, patched in its compat) divert 50% to the sky INSIDE the worker (after the pocket-redirect chokepoint) when: player buildings up there + standable unfogged colony-reachable edge cell + usable unforbidden stairs. Caravans stay surface. Setting skyVisitorArrivals default ON.
- **HOSPITALITY GUEST ROAMING** (Compat/ABHospitalityCompat.cs): (1) LORD RETENTION — Lord.Notify_PawnLost suppressed only when pawn == StairTransfer.Transferring AND lordjob is Hospitality LordJob_VisitColony (membership + triggers stay correct); (2) ROAM — idle guests in the VisitPoint stage (20% per 900t scan, max 2 away per group) tour linked levels that have guest beds or vending machines; while away they act as plain neutrals (guest services stay on the lord's level — disclosed); (3) RETURN — walked back when the lord leaves the visit stage or after ~20000t. Setting hospitalityRoaming default ON, ABGuard.Social, state load-cleared.
- **STRANDED-NEUTRAL SWEEP** (Systems/ABNeutralExit.cs): 600t cadence — lord-less friendly humanlikes on pocket levels with no column lord claiming them are walked to the surface (pocket edges are rock; exit resumes there). Safety net for visitors/guests/quest pawns however they got there. LordMembershipInColumn helper shared with the Hospitality sweep.
- **StairTransfer.Transferring** static marks the despawn->respawn window (used by lord retention; available for future transfer-scoped patches).

## LOGISTICS (island rework + RELAY + URGENT) — unchanged from 2026-07-24 3rd pass: StairIslands (forbid-gated), strict StairRouter, demand sites + islands, RELAY two-hop, export pin split + ignorePins, urgent fetch leg, event freshness, column architect. KNOWN GAPS unchanged (single nearest-exit scan for needs/gear/joy/medical/trade/rescue; map-wide consumable availability; relay anchor at first interchange; two-hop storage push middle-accept).

## AREAS / ZONES ACROSS LEVELS — unchanged (column-wide kind+label counterparts, InAllowedArea replacement, SeekAllowedArea walk-home, palette union). Stairs deliberately NOT area-gated (forbid comp is the passage control).

## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B) — unchanged (shot parity 14/14, auto-engage BUG1 neutral fix pending retest, CE direct fire verified).
## SKY DROP-POD LANDING — VERIFIED 7/7. SEE-BELOW / BASEMENTS / POD TRANSIT / AUR — unchanged.
## SETTINGS — seven tabs + new: skyVisitorArrivals, hospitalityRoaming (combat/threats tab block).

## Test plan (current)
- Batch B verify (isolated OK): anima-tree meditation pull, cross-level take-to-pen, Skip-cast a cell below, ritual with prisoner/animal role holder on another level.
- Batch C verify (NON-isolated or companionMods: Orion.Hospitality, joeownage.automatic.airships): rooftop landing zone -> airship lands up top; visitor group walks in on plateau; guests tour basement guest room and return at departure; stranded-neutral sweep.
- Older stack: relay/urgent with Allow Tool, BUG1 neutral CE retest, CE-absent palette run, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. CE. Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF. **NEW: Medieval Trader Airships (+legacy), Hospitality (Continued)** — both reflection-gated, inert without host. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (5th pass): Batches A (verified) + forbid (verified) + B + C all built, compile green. Next: Batch B verification test (isolated), then Batch C test with companion mods loaded.
